periods.analysis: Q1 actions: Hosted four navigation workshops at library branches for 74 residents and drafted visit checklists for clinic, hospital and portal use. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Bayview Medical Center.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add evening sessions for shift workers with the Seaport Workers Clinic.

periods.analysis: Q2 actions: Hosted six workshops, including the first evening session at the Seaport Workers Clinic, which filled. Attendance reached 118. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Bayview Medical Center, Seaport Workers Clinic.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Hold eight workshops with two evening sessions for shift workers, and hand out a checklist for each visit type.

periods.analysis: Q3 actions: Hosted eight workshops on coverage, billing and patient portals, with the Seaport Workers Clinic leading two evening sessions for shift workers. Attendees received a one-page checklist for each visit type. Partners: Harborview Community Health Center, Bayview Medical Center, Seaport Workers Clinic.
periods.recommendations: Next quarter: Add open enrollment sessions in October and train community health workers as navigators.
